exposure: laboratory reports (Random Blood Sugar (RBS) levels, Renal Function Tests (RFT))
cohort: The cohort consisted of 102 postoperative patients undergoing elective surgeries at a tertiary care hospital.
finding: The study demonstrated a significant association between co-morbidities and a poor Quality of Recovery score, underscoring the value of preanaesthesia check-ups in preventing perioperative morbidity.
